landing.subtitle: A lightweight widget to gather feedback. Screenshots, metadata, and automated delivery to Telegram or Notion.
landing.feature_screenshots_desc: Users can take a screenshot directly in the browser and crop the desired area.
landing.feature_telegram_desc: Bug reports go straight to your Telegram chat. Use our bot or connect your own.
landing.feature_notion_desc: Automatically create tickets in your Notion database with all fields filled out.
landing.feature_meta_desc: URL, browser, OS, screen size — everything is collected automatically.
landing.demo_desc_2: button in the bottom right corner — that is the widget.
landing.demo_hint: 👇 The widget is active on this page
landing.step_1_desc: Create an account and get your API key.
landing.step_2_desc: Paste 3 lines of code into your website.
landing.step_3_desc: Bugs arrive in Telegram, Notion, or your dashboard.
landing.cta_bottom_desc: Free registration. No credit card required.

auth.link_to_login: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.success_register: Account created! Check your email to confirm.

settings.api_key_desc: Use this key to install the widget on your site.
settings.config_desc: Configure the widget parameters and copy the snippet below.
settings.domains_desc: Specify domains allowed to send bug reports. Leave blank to accept from anywhere.
settings.visibility_desc: Choose who can see the bug report widget on your site.
settings.mode_public_desc: Widget is visible to all visitors
settings.mode_restricted_desc: Only accessible via Magic Link with password
settings.password_hint: Password is set. Leave blank to keep it unchanged.
settings.magic_link_hint: Add this parameter to your site's URL and send it to your tester. Don't forget to save settings!

reports.empty_desc: Install the widget on your site and send your first bug report.

integrations.subtitle: Connect services to receive bug reports in a convenient place.
integrations.desc_telegram: Receive bug reports directly to your Telegram chat.
integrations.desc_jira: Create Jira tasks from bug reports.
integrations.desc_slack: Send bug notifications to Slack channels.
integrations.desc_discord: Receive bug reports in Discord channels.
integrations.desc_email: Email notifications for new bug reports.
integrations.coming_soon: This integration will be available soon. Stay tuned!
integrations.tg_desc: Receive bug reports directly to your Telegram chat.
integrations.tg_bot_system_desc: Quick start — only Chat ID needed
integrations.tg_bot_custom_desc: Full control — provide your own token
integrations.tg_inst_sys_1: Start a dialog or add our bot to the group:
integrations.tg_inst_sys_3: Copy the Chat ID and paste it below
integrations.tg_inst_cus_2: Copy the token and paste it below
integrations.tg_inst_cus_3: Add the bot to a chat/group and provide the Chat ID
integrations.notion_desc: Connect Notion to automatically create bug reports as entries in your database.
integrations.notion_step_2: Select a page for the database
integrations.notion_step_3: Done! The '🐞 Errora Bug Reports' database will be created automatically
integrations.discord_desc: Receive bug reports directly to a Discord channel.
integrations.discord_inst_1: Go to the Discord Developer Portal
integrations.discord_inst_2: Create app → Bot → copy Bot Token
integrations.discord_inst_3: Enable MESSAGE CONTENT INTENT in bot settings
integrations.discord_inst_4: Add bot to server (OAuth2 → scope: bot, permissions: Send Messages, Embed Links)
integrations.discord_inst_5: Copy the Channel ID of the desired channel (Right click → 'Copy Channel ID', developer mode must be enabled)
integrations.slack_desc: Connect Slack to automatically send bug reports to the selected channel.
integrations.slack_step_3: Done! Bug reports will arrive in Slack
